Antoine and Amandine are two employees who truly stand out in my opinion. It's the first time I've had a cat, and he's been a part of my life for two years now. My cat has some food allergies, and Antoine and Amandine have repeatedly given me exceptional advice, taking the time to carefully check the ingredient list.

Antoine even remembers the products: on my next visit, without even checking my customer file, he remembered exactly which brand he had recommended and asked about my cat's health. It's a very touching gesture that makes all the difference.
For her part, Amandine is a real lifesaver. I have an invisible disability, and she always offers to help me carry my heaviest purchases to my car. I am immensely grateful to her.

The other employees are also very helpful; the whole team is wonderful, and the store is always impeccably clean. But the attention and dedication of Antoine and Amandine particularly stand out.

A very unpleasant experience. The employees' attitude leaves much to be desired: a superficial cordiality mixed with a rigidity that shows no consideration for the customer. They seem friendly at first, but as soon as a situation doesn't suit them, they become rigid, strict, and inflexible, without showing the slightest willingness to listen or adapt. A feeling I've often experienced during trips to France.

It was very, very far from the usual approach here, where the service is generally warmer, more friendly, and above all, focused on listening to and helping the customer. Truly disappointing!

In response to Mondou's message: my message is very clear. You can reread it if needed.

I have no concerns; I simply don't intend to go to Mondou again. It's you who should be concerned.

Don't subscribe to Monsieur's pet food service. If the carrier fails to deliver, customer service has no solution to offer. Basically, the dog doesn't get its food, but nobody cares.
I absolutely do not recommend them.
I like Mondou for the diversity of things for sale and I really liked the young salesman who was very kind and welcoming!
